recovery.status_unavailable: Recovery status is temporarily unavailable. The external watchdog continues independently.

categories.needs_you_why: Work is waiting for your direction.
categories.incident_why: This changed risk, availability, or the expected result.
categories.update_why: The work crossed a milestone worth knowing about.
categories.completion_why: The independently verified business result is complete.
categories.history_why: Kept for context; no action is required.

owner_control.sms_authority: SMS is an alert only. Respond or inspect evidence here in the authenticated control center.
owner_control.direct_work_help: These instructions are recorded on this issue and sent to its assigned worker. They do not reuse approval as permission for a different change.
owner_control.directive_instruction: Add the exact details below, then select {{action}} again.
owner_control.detail_instruction: Add the exact correction, accepted portion, scope, fact, or question below, then submit again.
owner_control.comment_placeholder: Add context, correct the plan, or explain what must change…
owner_control.legacy_warning: This older request has no atomic decision receipt. Comment or inspect the issue; approval controls stay disabled so a reply cannot be recorded without proof.

labels.autopilot_quota_blocked: Run blocked because the limit was reached

toasts.source_context_retry_started: Retry started with the original context

errors.source_context_retry_failed: Could not retry with the original context
errors.source_context_retry_unavailable: This context can no longer be retried. Start again from the branch point.
errors.mark_all_read_failed: Failed to mark all as read

owner_route.enable: Declare review and release roles for this issue
owner_route.help: Authorize this sequence using existing squad members on one host. Each worker uses its selected account and runtime. Existing squad settings stay unchanged.
owner_route.choose: Choose an existing agent or squad
owner_route.interruption: Allow a brief deployment-only interruption. No offline maintenance or device reservations.
owner_route.incomplete: Choose all roles on the same host. Review must differ from implementation; verification must differ from release.

preview.drag_to_annotate: Drag over anything you want changed

preview.open_new_tab: Open it in a new tab

operational_copy.autonomous_empty_description: The team is carrying on by itself. Something shows up here when a call is genuinely yours to make.
operational_copy.incident_alert_description: This is an incident alert, not a request for a comment. The run stopped because the worker/provider failed; the issue remains available for inspection.
